test_emergency_recovery.test_crash_after.assertion: A closure journal surviving a crash requires broker re-verification before accounting.

test_emergency_recovery.test_lock_none_c.assertion: Missing ownership blocks writes, keeps state bytes and sends no order mutations.

test_emergency_recovery.test_old_live_lo.assertion: A separate aged live state-lock owner remains exclusive. After process death a new owner acquires the same inode.

test_emergency_recovery.test_opaque_lega.assertion: Opaque legacy state lock fences writes despite its age.

test_emergency_recovery.test_stale_load_.assertion: Stale snapshot save raises and preserves the newer state.

test_entry_protection.test_late_partial_.assertion: Late partial fill is protected exactly once at the verified fill size despite lost acknowledgement.

test_entry_protection.test_monitor_rejec.assertion: Rejected amendment preserves the prior stop and only a confirmed retry advances it.

test_entry_protection.test_restart_after.assertion: Restart preserves the already published active trade and does not duplicate its stop.

test_entry_release_parity.test_equity_lo.assertion: CHOPPY returns no equity candidate for either direction while TRENDING preserves the direction.

test_entry_release_parity.test_live_tick.assertion: Midday bypasses the equity scan, CHOPPY bypasses entry, and the afternoon positive control reaches submission.

test_entry_release_parity.test_order_sub.assertion: Both equity and options allow the four inclusive endpoints and deny adjacent off-window minutes with zero submissions.

test_entry_release_parity.test_submissio.assertion: CHOPPY equity is denied with zero sends and TRENDING equity sends once.

test_exit_fence_permutations.test_verifi.assertion: Corroborated unrelated exposure can recover in both directions and orderings while the disputed trade stays fenced.

test_exit_invalidation.test_exact_match_.assertion: Exact durable exit proof replays accounting once without broker reads.

test_migration.test_live_flag_passes_wri.assertion: Standalone guard passes a supported write when the switch is set.

test_preflight.test_expiry_policy_and_ex.assertion: Expiry must match the calendar and explicit supported session rules.

test_preflight.test_latest_quote_price_t.assertion: Quote lookup accepts a matching fresh quote and rejects bad amounts, timestamps, response status and instrument identity.

test_preflight.test_malformed_future_mis.assertion: Malformed, stale, future and missing bars fail readiness.

test_preflight.test_pending_entries_and_.assertion: Both pending entry and protective orders cause nonzero readiness.

test_preflight.test_unverified_price_blo.assertion: Bad quote evidence blocks entry and chase.

test_reconcile.test_actual_fee_contradic.assertion: Contradictory previously persisted actual charge evidence must fence replay without changing journal or state.

test_reconcile.test_actual_short_partial.assertion: Verified partial fills and actual charges reconcile trade-scoped P&L and replay does not double count.

test_reconcile.test_api_failure_or_order.assertion: Read failure and contradictory orders persist UNKNOWN, never flat.

test_reconcile.test_net_after_fees_and_l.assertion: Verified exits across routes apply estimated net risk once and record late actual charges separately.

test_role_permissions.test_status_missin.assertion: Missing or expired tokens cannot construct the SDK, renew, or send PUT even when the enable switch is set.

test_safe_behavior.test_p2_partial_fill_.assertion: Partial protection and journal use actual filled quantity.

test_safe_behavior.test_p5_duplicate_tic.assertion: A running owner excludes a duplicate tick.

test_scheduled_eod.test_cutoff_scheduler.assertion: Both contenders converge to verified flat under scheduled ownership.

test_scheduled_eod.test_entry_intent_cro.assertion: Crossing cutoff during entry intent save prevents entry and leaves verified EOD cleanup.

test_scheduled_eod.test_hung_pre_cutoff_.assertion: Hung owner causes bounded nonzero result and restart resumes the scheduled incident.

test_verified_exits.test_authorized_cli_.assertion: Live CLI flatten reports nonzero on unresolved evidence and completes once the mock position and order evidence verify flat.

test_write_safety.test_authorized_premar.assertion: Explicitly authorized premarket repairs the IP with HTTP mocks.

test_write_safety.test_authorized_reconn.assertion: Live enablement preserves place, modify and cancel access on reconnect.
